_comment: The Pi Durable Platform mark (inner SVG markup on the 64 grid). The logo isn't chosen yet: this is a neutral stand-in (an outlined square on the family's dark tile), the same drawing as the website's lib/mark.json. `svg` is the drawing for 20 to 47 px, used by components/logo.tsx (28 px, nav bar); `svgRegular` the drawing for 48 px and up. `npm run logo -- --placeholder` draws the favicons, icons and og.png from it. Once ../pdp-assets/logo/<chosen>/ exists, `npm run logo -- <chosen>` (scripts/sync-logo.mjs) rewrites this file from its mark-small.svg and mark.svg, sets placeholder to false and copies the favicons, icons and og-card into public/. Change the website's copy too, and commit.
